Name: Customize Exterior
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b][color=red][size=4]This mod is deprecated.[/size][/color][/b]
It's compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.4 and 1.5.5, but may not be updated for future versions. Consider using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] instead.


----------------------------------------------------------

[b]Customize Exterior[/b] lets you customize the exterior of your buildings individually. This lets you have a different texture for each instance of a building.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
[b][size=3]Adding textures[/size][/b]
This mod has no built-in custom textures; you need to download the textures you want to use.

Customize Exterior will create a [font=Courier New]Buildings[/font] subfolder the first time you run it. You can install any number of texture sets by putting each one in its own subfolder of [font=Courier New]Buildings[/font]. The name of each file should match the building in your game's [font=Courier New]Content/Buildings[/font] folder. Each texture can be a [font=Courier New].png[/font] or [font=Courier New].xnb[/font] file.

For example:
[code]? Mods/
? CustomizeExterior/
? Buildings/
? TextureSetA
? Shed.xnb
? houses.xnb
...
? TextureSetB
? Shed.png
? houses.png
...
[/code]
You can make textures seasonal by adding season folders within the texture set:
[code]? Mods/
? CustomizeExterior/
? Buildings/
? TextureSetA
? spring/
? Shed.xnb
? houses.xnb
...
? summer/
? Shed.xnb
? houses.xnb
...
? fall/
? Shed.xnb
? houses.xnb
...
? winter/
? Shed.xnb
? houses.xnb
...
[/code]
[b][size=3]Applying textures in-game[/size][/b]
Double right-click a building in-game to show the texture selection UI, and choose the texture to apply.

[b][size=3]Textures in screenshot[/size][/b]
For the texture sets shown in the screenshot, see:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/583]Birch Building Mods[/url]
[*][s][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/419]Medieval Modern Buildings[/url][/s]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/928]Seasonal Vanilla[/url]
[*][s][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/682]Victorian Era Buildings[/url][/s]
[*][s][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/891]Seasonal Victorian Buildings[/url][/s]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.
